# Keyboard reference

Generated by `mix swarm_code.keymap` from the bindings table.
Do not edit by hand.

Keys are read against one *context* at a time.

## Composer

### Navigate

| Keys | Does |
|---|---|
| `PgDn` | Scroll one page down |
| `Ctrl-D` | On an empty draft, scroll half a page |
| `{{` | a literal pair of braces |
